title: PanTS lesion outlining with varied training views

control.title: Original PanTS-only 24k course-reference recipe
control.reuse: Require changed-factor audit; no automatic new control run

hypotheses.delta: Selected treatment minus selected control native positive-case macro lesion Dice

fixed_recipe.initialization: Original SuPreM backbone and seed42 fresh three-class head, never trained-parent weights
fixed_recipe.roi: Existing provided-pancreas geometry-v2, 10mm margin, 1mm intermediate sampling then fit-to-cube

augmentation.valid_support: Geometric unpadded rectangle from pad_low and normalized_shape, transformed with image and targets
augmentation.padding: Exactly zero; not inferred from CT intensity or anatomy labels
augmentation.rng: NumPy PCG64, first8 SHA256 bytes little-endian of UTF8 policy:seed:one_based_update:case_id

evaluation.selection: Highest positive tensor macro Dice at 2000..24000 by2000; earliest exact tie; ordinary weights only
evaluation.primary: Selected-best versus selected-best native provided-pancreas positive macro Dice, all36 including misses
evaluation.mandatory_secondary: Terminal24k versus terminal24k; cannot substitute for primary
evaluation.inference: Unchanged native scorer, three-class argmax, no tuning
evaluation.interval: percentile95, conditional on selected models and reused development cohort
evaluation.accept: delta>=0.02 AND CI.lower>0 AND all guardrails pass at valid completed horizon
evaluation.reject: Any guardrail failure OR CI.upper<0.02 at valid completed horizon
evaluation.null_decision: Reject H0 iff CI.lower>0; otherwise H0 not rejected, never accepted
evaluation.invalid: Scientific identity, reference, cohort or leakage defect
evaluation.operational_failure: Interrupted or resource-failed before completion, not scientific rejection
